description: Canonical Personal Wellness Blueprint outcomes linking user-stated wellness goals directly to body systems and biological mechanisms. Outcomes are the single goal/outcome vocabulary used throughout PWB - the same OUT-codes the questionnaire (PF014) offers as goal choices, that products and foods are tagged/scored against, and that PriorityScorer applies as a body-system bonus. The separate goals.json layer (GOAL### ids sitting between user intent and outcomes) has been retired as an unused extra layer - it was never read by any scoring code and the questionnaire already asked for outcomes directly.

outcomes.name: Better Sleep
outcomes.description: Support better sleep quality and restorative recovery.

outcomes.name: More Energy
outcomes.description: Support energy, vitality and physical stamina.

outcomes.name: Healthy Weight Management
outcomes.description: Support healthy weight and body composition.

outcomes.name: Better Fitness & Physical Performance
outcomes.description: Support physical fitness, strength, stamina and exercise performance.

outcomes.name: Digestive & Gut Health
outcomes.description: Support digestive comfort, regularity and healthy gut function.

outcomes.name: Mental Clarity & Performance Sharpness
outcomes.description: Support concentration, focus, memory and cognitive sharpness - whether for everyday life, study, or performing at your best under pressure at work.

outcomes.name: Mobility & Joint Health
outcomes.description: Support mobility, joint function and comfortable movement.

outcomes.name: Healthy Ageing & Resilience
outcomes.description: Support resilience, function and wellbeing across ageing.

outcomes.name: Menopause Transition Resilience

outcomes.name: Heart & Cardiovascular Health
